cv.name: Callum Garside
cv.headline: Quality Engineer | ISO 9001 | Former chef turned manufacturing quality
cv.summary: Spent six years running professional kitchens, where HACCP and audits were part of the job, before retraining in mechanical engineering. Now a Quality Engineer in precision machining, handling inspection, NCRs and root-cause work.

experience.title: Quality Engineer
bullets: Own non-conformance reports and 8D investigations for aerospace and rail customers
Write PPAP and first article inspection packs (AS9102)
Reduced internal scrap on a high-volume bracket line by 22% through a gauge R&R study and fixture change
Support ISO 9001 and AS9100 internal audits

experience.title: Quality Inspector
bullets: CMM and manual inspection to drawings; recording results in the QMS
Started using Minitab for SPC charts on bending operations

experience.title: Sous Chef
bullets: Ran HACCP records and passed every EHO inspection with a 5 rating
Managed stock, suppliers and a team of six
